verses.1: We do not deserve it, O LORD. We do not deserve to receive honor for Your kindness and love toward us.
verses.2: Why should the nations say, “Who is their God?”
verses.3: And our God, in the heavens, has done everything that He desired.
verses.4: Their decorations are made of gold and silver, which are products of human craftsmanship.
verses.5: They shall not speak, and their eyes shall not see.
verses.6: My ears will not hear them, nor will they be able to smell anything from them.
verses.7: Their hands will not be able to move their feet, and they will not be able to walk unless they are guided by someone who knows how to lead them.
verses.8: Just as they, their works will be like all those who trust in them.
verses.9: Israel will be safe in the Lord’s help and protection.
verses.10: The house of Aaron trusted in Jehovah for their help and protection.
verses.11: The fear of the LORD is the source of their strength and protection.
verses.12: May the LORD remember us, and may He bless the house of Israel. May He also bless the house of Aaron.
verses.13: May the eyes of Jehovah bless both the small and the great.
verses.14: The LORD will bless you, you and your children.
verses.15: Be faithful to Jehovah, who makes the heavens and the earth.
verses.16: The heavens belong to Jehovah, and the earth was given to human beings.
verses.17: Not the dead will praise her, nor will all those who descend from Dumah.
verses.18: And we bless Him from this day forward, forever. Praise Him!
